summary.text: Jill Dickman is a Republican member of the Nevada State Assembly representing District 31 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She previously held the seat from 2014 to 2016 and returned to it in 2020; Ballotpedia lists her profession as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Jill Dickman was born in Hancock, Michigan, and graduated from L'Anse High School; her career experience includes co-owning Total Resource Industries.
She served in the Nevada State Assembly for District 31 from 2014 to 2016 and assumed office again on November 4, 2020, succeeding Skip Daly.
For the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Growth and Infrastructure, Legislative Operations and Elections, and Ways and Means committees.
Her Democratic opponent in the 2026 general election is Neal Schwartz.
